trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, deep V-shaped central depression visible at the junction of the two fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible irregular serrations along the trailing boundary of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude jagged peaks near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex curve on the trailing edge of the left lobe extending to a tapered tip; right lobe exhibits a more linear sweep with a blunt terminal end.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-intensity white pigmentation or scarring localized at the extreme distal tip of the right fluke lobe.
